summary: Full parking lane of cars on Blair Drive backing onto open parkland.
reasons: Backs onto park, no dwellings nearby
Dozens of cars parked along this kerb

best_section.where: Blair Drive north kerb opposite the Joyce Ackroyd building, beside the basketball court park

drivers.seclusion: Park and basketball court on the kerb side; only university buildings across the road, no homes.
drivers.access_and_room: Marked parking lane along the kerb, filled with cars in both images.
drivers.traffic: Campus through road; moderate traffic, likely busy by day.
drivers.convention: Cars park nose to tail here, so a van blends in; metered signs apply Mon-Fri 7am-9pm.

flags: Bus zone and no stopping signs near the ends of the stretch
sun_shade: Open to sun from the north and east; some tree shade near 60 m.
